limitations: Saved local practice-model evidence only, not an official STP result, score or docking claim. No simulation or reflight is performed by this publisher.
Only allowlisted ownship measurements and derived metrics are published. Camera, raw radar, descriptors, source snapshots, exception strings, credentials and hidden debris are absent.

The launch_route_reference frame is fixed at the first ownship position S and initial target G. Along is dot(p-S,e1), where e1=(G-S)/|G-S|. Lateral uses the normalized projection of the least-parallel Cartesian axis onto the plane perpendicular to e1, with X/Y/Z tie order. Normal uses e3=e1 cross e2. Lateral and normal are signed, not geographic or terrain normals.
Every trial shares the published start, initial target and basis within 1e-6 m for anchors and 1e-9 for unit axes. The target may move; the route frame never follows it.

Commands stored with observation row t were applied during the PREVIOUS interval, not the next interval. accel_mps2 and angular_accel_rad_s2 are requested command magnitudes; ax_mps2, ay_mps2 and az_mps2 are requested body-frame components, not route-frame or measured total accelerations. Initial commands are null because no previous interval exists.

command_from_s is the actual preceding observation timestamp for the recorded command. The request was held from command_from_s until time_s. Thinning does not stretch it to the previous retained sample or interpolate omitted requests.
fuel_kg means cumulative mission.fuel_used_kg, a local physical fuel-use estimate, not remaining stored fuel or the official STP fuel counter. damage_j is cumulative local damage.
Range and relative speed use public mission measurements, or public ownship/target navigation when that measurement is absent. Missing measurements stay null, never zero.

nearest_radar_m is the smallest range in the same observation's public radar rows. max_radar_age_s is the largest row age on the simulation clock. Negative noisy ranges and negative ages from future timestamps are retained as diagnostics, not discarded or clamped. Neither is hidden nearest debris truth, a collision margin, or proof that unobserved space is clear.

terrain_clearance_m is radial centre clearance from public ownship position and the same-row reported terrain radius. It is null without both readings. No terrain model, enclosing-radius substitute, hull clearance or debris clearance is inferred.

Samples are actual observations, not interpolated trajectories. Deterministic thinning retains first/last observations, every observed damage-increase bracket, and both sides of every null gap. Unsampled motion and contacts remain unknown.

Damage events bracket increases between known damage readings; their value is cumulative damage, not an exact contact time or cause. A terminal marker denotes the last saved observation, including timeout and software-error partial horizons, not an inferred event.
Same-seed, same-repetition runs are paired within this cohort only. Repetitions are not independent seeds. Different comparison files may use different worlds and engine builds.

The original per-trial runs.csv is incomplete: some numeric cells are missing or its zero sample counts are unavailable placeholders. CSV identities, outcomes and populated measurements were checked. Exported finals and sample counts were re-derived from saved trace.jsonl with current analyze_run, not recovered from the missing table. Recomputed group metrics were checked against saved summary.csv. The original CSV was not rewritten.
